# glpi_device_processor (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI processor model in the device catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_device_processor" "by_name" {
  name = "Intel Xeon Gold 6338"
}

data "glpi_device_processor" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Designation of the processor. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `default_cores` (Number) Default number of cores.
- `default_frequency` (Number) Default frequency in MHz.
- `default_threads` (Number) Default number of threads.
- `frequency` (Number) Frequency in MHz.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the manufacturer.
